incidents.description: Stop hook checks legacy NO_TOOL_CALL and payload.cwd, ignoring Antigravity Stop payloads (model_stop, workspacePaths, fullyIdle).

referenceOutput.summary: Stop hook ignores Antigravity model_stop and workspacePaths fields.

findings.claim: evaluateStop rejects Antigravity Stop terminationReason model_stop and ignores workspacePaths array.
findings.evidence: Piping {terminationReason:'model_stop',workspacePaths:[tmp]} returned allow on dirty repo.
findings.suggestedFix: Normalize model_stop/NO_TOOL_CALL and workspacePaths[0]/cwd via envelope.mjs.
